Synopsis:
    Amazon is launching its first-ever sterling-denominated bond sale across four maturities (3, 6, 12, 19 years), potentially pricing as early as Wednesday. This is part of a broader trend of hyperscalers (Amazon, Alphabet, etc.) diversifying bond issuance outside USD markets to fund massive AI infrastructure capex. Investor demand in USD credit markets is showing signs of saturation, pushing issuers into GBP, EUR, CHF and JPY markets.
